newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PT sell-off seen H2 97, state keeps 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: PT sell-off seen H2 97, state keeps 25 pct.

text.p: The third stage of the privatisation of Portugal Telecom in the second half of 1997 will include the sale of a 26 percent stake and the state will keep a 25 percent "golden share", Planning Minister Joao Cravinho said.
"The third stage privatisation of PT will take place between the summer and autumn," Cravinho told Reuters.
The government sold off 49 percent of PT's capital in two stages in 1995 and 1996.
"The state will always keep a 'golden share' of 25 percent of PT," Cravinho said.
"The remaining 26 percent could be floated on the bourse, or if there is some advantage, a partner could take a small percentage," he added.
PT shares closed yesterday up 90 escudos to 4,935 in volume of 522,140 shares.
